verevonRelevance: Default-deny permissions with an origin allowlist; log decisions.

name: Local app:// protocol with path-traversal guard; strict CSP and SRI on local windows
what: Slack's own HTML windows load from a custom protocol that cannot read outside the app folder and run under a tight content-security policy.
how: protocol.handle("app") accepts only host "resources", rejects ".." and any path resolving outside __dirname, serves with net.fetch(file URL); app://error returns an empty body; registerSchemesAsPrivileged gives app standard+secure, plus a dev scheme with bypassCSP. Each component HTML has a CSP (default-src self + app + app.slack.com, script-src sha384 hash, object-src none, frame-src none, restricted img-src) and a matching SRI integrity attribute; notifications bundle includes DOMPurify/Trusted Types.
verevonRelevance: Local UI surfaces in any host should ship with hash-pinned scripts and a path-safe custom protocol.

name: Download safety: trusted-host gate, verified-download registry, dangerous-extension prompts
what: Files only download from Slack file hosts; "Open" and "Show in folder" only act on files the app itself downloaded; risky types (.exe, .bat, .js, .msi ...) warn first, common documents open without warning.
how: A hidden download BrowserWindow loads the URL and the session will-download event is matched by file id; the URL host must pass the trusted-host check; HYDRATE_VERIFIED_DOWNLOADS rebuilds a map id -> path from completed entries and TRIGGER_DOWNLOAD_SHELL_ACTION verifies the stored path equals the registry before shell.showItemInFolder/openPath; extension lists: dangerous (.bat .bin .cmd .command .com .exe .js .msi .pl .py .rb .sh .vb) vs known-safe (images, media, office, pdf, archives); file-handler-info finds the default app for the "will open in {appName}" dialog.
verevonRelevance: Agent-produced files in Spaces need the same "only open what the system wrote and registered" rule and type-based warnings.
notes: Quality 5: the renderer cannot ask the shell to open arbitrary paths.

name: Certificate errors are reported, never bypassed
what: TLS errors are not click-through: the app records them for diagnostics and leaves Chromium's default rejection in place.
how: certificate-error handler logs domain, issuer, subject, fingerprint and validity, emits desktop_certificate_error once per domain with a before/after/ok validity status, and does not call the callback with true.
verevonRelevance: Enterprise proxies break TLS; surfacing a diagnosable "certificate problem" panel beats silent failure.
notes: Related user-facing copy: renderer locale "Check your network settings or any security software".

name: Token-binding hints (DPoP) and per-domain key lifecycle
what: Sign-in links can say that tokens require DPoP (proof-of-possession), and the shell keeps and deletes per-domain key files accordingly.
how: Deep-link token sets carry <n>.dpop=1 -> requiresDpop on the sign-in request; userData/dpop-keys/<domain> files are removed when no remaining workspace uses that domain; key generation and proof signing were not located in this bundle (likely native or web side).
verevonRelevance: Sender-constrained tokens for agents/hosts reduce replay risk for Control-issued decisions.
notes: Medium: only the lifecycle edges were found.

name: Electron fuses and package capabilities in the shipped executable
what: The installed Slack.exe has the dangerous Electron escape hatches turned off and integrity checks on.
how: Fuse sentinel at byte offset 199176568 in Slack.exe: wire version 1, 9 fuses "010011001". With the @electron/fuses v2 ordering (INF) that reads: RunAsNode off, EnableCookieEncryption on, NODE_OPTIONS env var off, --inspect CLI args off, embedded ASAR integrity validation on, only-load-app-from-asar on, browser-process V8 snapshot off, file-protocol extra privileges off, WASM trap handlers on. MSIX capabilities: runFullTrust + internetClient. Runtime string: Chrome 152.0.7977.130, Electron 44.4.5.
evidence: install:C:/Program Files/WindowsApps/com.tinyspeck.slackdesktop_4.52.178.0_x64__8yrtsj140pw4g/app/Slack.exe byte offset 199176568 (Electron fuse sentinel, wire version 1, 9 fuses = 010011001; Chrome/152.0.7977.130 Electron/44.4.5 string present)
verevonRelevance: Ship any Electron/Tauri host with fuses/hardening locked and verify them in CI.
notes: Fuse positions follow the @electron/fuses enum order (confidence medium on the mapping; the raw bits are certain). Read from the installed binary, read-only.

name: Toast and link hardening: XML escaping, launch-URI guard, image-host allowlist, validated activation
what: Notification content from other people cannot inject markup or malicious links into Windows toasts.
how: vO() escapes & < > " ' in every toast field; guardLaunchUri replaces any non-slack: launchUri with slack://noop; avatar/hero image URLs must belong to Slack image hosts else are dropped; images are downloaded to a temp cache named by md5(url); toast activation arguments are parsed as JSON and validated against alternatives (notification, action, header) before anything runs.
verevonRelevance: Treat notification payloads from agents and other members as untrusted input: escape, allowlist hosts and links, validate activation.

name: Log and state redaction at export and per-action payload allowlists
what: When logs or state are exported for support, file names, workspace names, URLs and download paths are replaced with [REDACTED]; routine logging records only chosen fields.
how: Regexes redact files-pri/files-tmb URL names, filename= and filename*= values; state-file export rewrites downloads.*.downloadPath, teams.*.team_name/team_url/name and workspaces.*.name/domain/url/icon; action creators use logPayload selectors (for example notifications log only content/title/body-length fields or nothing for credentials); basic-auth requests log uploadData as [REDACTED].
verevonRelevance: Directly applicable to Verevon support bundles and ZDR: redact by schema path, not by regex alone.

name: Proxy and site authentication dialog (NTLM/basic) with credentials kept out of logs
what: When a proxy or site asks for credentials, Slack shows its own login window and supports NTLM domain lists pushed from the web app.
how: SHOW_AUTH_DIALOG epic with basic-auth-view component window (modal child), SUBMIT_CREDENTIALS IPC (username/password logPayload redacted), connectivityPrefs.ntlmCredentialDomains, --proxy-server flag and desktop_proxy_info telemetry.
verevonRelevance: Corporate proxy support is a real adoption blocker for enterprise desktop clients.

name: Three sign-in methods: browser, platform-native (system auth sheet) and native direct-SAML
what: Slack can sign in through the default browser, through an OS authentication session (macOS), or by starting SAML directly inside the app; policy can pin a default workspace.
how: Enum signInMethod = browser | platform-native | platform-native-direct-saml; boot URL carries aswebauth=1 for the native methods; sign-in URLs /ssb/signin, /ssb/signin_redirect, /ssb/add are intercepted and handled natively (START_NATIVE_AUTH epic using electron-native-auth); policy DefaultSignInTeam preselects an org; feature flag mas_native_platform_sign_in_by_default changes the default for Mac App Store builds.
verevonRelevance: Enterprise SSO for a desktop shell should avoid embedded login pages; mirror the browser/native/direct options per org policy.

name: Magic-link login through a hidden window, with navigation limited to Slack hosts
what: Clicking a magic sign-in link completes the login inside the app without the user doing more.
how: The shell loads the magic-login URL in a hidden BrowserWindow sharing the main session (preload returns the page text as JSON {ok|error} over IPC), blocks will-navigate to non-Slack hosts, flushes cookies to disk and checks the d and lc auth cookies; token sets from login-v2 links are processed for several workspaces in parallel (forkJoin).
verevonRelevance: Passwordless handoff from web to desktop is smooth UX; require the tokens to be single-use and bound (DPoP-style).

name: Enterprise-aware workspace model: org user team (E...) with member workspaces (T...), variants commercial/gov
what: The shell knows that one user identity (an org-level team id starting with E) maps to several workspaces (ids starting with T), each with a name, domain, icon set, order and commercial/gov variant.
how: STORE_USER_WORKSPACES {userTeamId, workspaceIds[]} fills userWorkspaces; SYNC_WORKSPACES supplies workspaces {id, name, domain, url, icon sizes 34-original, order, variant}; ids are validated with ^(E|T)[A-Z0-9]{8,50}$ patterns; deep-link team params resolve through userWorkspaces membership.
verevonRelevance: Model org -> spaces membership in the host state exactly as Control returns it; never infer access from a link.
notes: Interpretation of E/T as Enterprise/Team is INF from the regex and Slack conventions.

name: Commercial vs GovSlack/restricted/military client environments with domain families and mode-switching
what: The same app can serve Slack commercial and government clouds; it switches modes when the user signs into or out of gov workspaces and tells the user.
how: clientEnvironment 1000 (normal), 1001 (restricted, GovSlack), 1002 (military); domain families slack.com/.eu, slack-gov.com, slack.mil and -dev variants (app, files, imgs, msgs); SWITCH_CLIENT_FEATURE_MODE_VIA_SIGN_OUT/DEEP_LINK/MAGIC_LINK epics flip the mode, CLEAR_SERVICE_WORKER purges the old service worker, a native notification announces "GovSlack was activated/deactivated"; UA gets GovEnvironment; some features are replaced by gov-safe handlers (registry in the preload getAvailableFeatures).
verevonRelevance: Data-residency / sovereign modes need a client-level environment switch with cache purge, not just server routing.
notes: Policy docs list 1000/1001; code also has 1002 (military).

name: Sign-out, browser sign-out and "Reset App Data" flows
what: Signing out of a workspace removes it and cleans local data; users can also sign out via the browser; Reset App Data signs out everywhere and returns the app to first-run.
how: REMOVE_TEAMS IPC -> SIGN_OUT_BROWSER (opens /ssb/signout/<team> externally), SIGN_OUT_CLEANUP (clearData, cookie purge, dpop keys), CLOSE_WINDOWS_ON_SIGNOUT; menu item Reset App Data with confirm dialog "This will sign you out from all of your workspaces".
verevonRelevance: Space membership removal (member revocation) should trigger the equivalent local purge for any native cache.

name: Web-driven menu extension API with positioning and badges
what: The web app can add its own items to native menus (global and per workspace), position them relative to existing groups and show badges (alerts, updates, new items).
how: window.desktop.menus.extendMenu / extendWorkspaceMenu(workspaceId, items) -> EXTEND_MENU; items use Electron menu fields plus order, before/after/beforeGroupContaining/afterGroupContaining, accessibilityLabel, badge {content,count,type}; clicks come back as CUSTOM_MENU_ITEM_CLICKED -> desktopDelegate.customMenuItemClicked; feature_desktop_extend_app_menu flag.
verevonRelevance: A host-side extension point for plugin/agent-provided menu items (with badges) would let Verevon skills surface in OS chrome safely.

name: Chrome-style context-menu registration for the web app
what: The web app can register context-menu items scoped by URL patterns and contexts, like a browser extension, and the shell shows them on right-click with spelling suggestions and link/image actions.
how: contextMenus.create({id,title,contexts,documentUrlPatterns,targetUrlPatterns,parentId,type,...}) -> CREATE_CONTEXT_MENU (schema et mirrors chrome.contextMenus) and CONTEXT_MENU_CLICKED back; native menu built from params (linkURL, srcURL, selectionText, misspelledWord, dictionarySuggestions, mediaType, editFlags).
verevonRelevance: Context actions on messages/links ("Ask agent about this") are cheap extensibility wins.

name: OS search-index plumbing (Spotlight-style items) present but disabled in this Windows build
what: The shell can add and remove items (messages, files) in the operating system's search index so they show up in system search, but on this Windows build availability reports false.
how: IPC IS_SEARCH_INDEXING_AVAILABLE (hard-coded false here), ADD_TO_SEARCH_INDEX(items[{identifier, contentDescription, domainIdentifier, title, expirationDate, iconURL}]), REMOVE_FROM_SEARCH_INDEX, REMOVE_ALL_FROM_SEARCH_INDEX; items delegate to slack-desktop-utils search module when loaded (native addToIndex/removeFromIndex/removeAllFromIndex/isIndexingAvailable); schema mirrors CoreSpotlight attributes; window.desktop.search exposes it.
verevonRelevance: OS-level indexing of Space titles/artifacts is a discovery differentiator but conflicts with ZDR; make it opt-in per org.
notes: Native export names confirmed from the .node strings; macOS implementation is INF.

name: Flag-gated local file search and Ctrl+F routed to in-app search
what: A feature-flagged IPC lets the web app search recent local files; the Find command opens Slack's own search instead of a page-find bar.
how: SEARCH_LOCAL_FILES(query, options) returns file metadata (name, extension, size, times, thumb) from a directory scan when desktop_local_file_search is on; editing command "find" sends START_SEARCH to the web app (desktopDelegate.startSearch).
evidence: slack/dist/main.bundle.cjs#c1335764 find routed to in-app search
verevonRelevance: Route Ctrl+F/Ctrl+K to Space search once Space search exists (today absent).
notes: Scanned directory constant (yT) not resolved.

name: DOC: desktop keyboard model (quick switcher, new message, jump to unread, Activity, All unreads)
what: Navigation is keyboard-first: quick switcher, new message, search, jump to unread, previous/next unread, All unreads and Activity views have dedicated shortcuts.
how: Windows: Ctrl+K/Ctrl+T (desktop only) switcher, Ctrl+N or Ctrl+Shift+K new message, Ctrl+G search, Ctrl+F search in conversation, Ctrl+J jump to latest unread, Alt+Shift+Up/Down previous/next unread, Ctrl+Shift+A All unreads, Ctrl+Shift+M Activity; no command palette listed.
verevonRelevance: Space needs Cmd/Ctrl+K switching and unread jumping; Verevon's Cmd/Ctrl+K currently opens web search only.

name: Rich clipboard: write text/PNG, and multi-format set-and-paste with restore
what: Copy actions write text or images to the system clipboard, and a "set and paste" operation can place several formats at once, paste, then restore the previous clipboard.
how: WRITE_STRING_TO_CLIPBOARD (clipboard.writeText), WRITE_IMAGE_TO_CLIPBOARD (base64 -> nativeImage -> ClipboardItem image/png), SET_AND_PASTE_CLIPBOARD -> slack-desktop-utils clipboard.setAndPaste(formats{<=16 formats, each <=10 MB}, {restoreDelayMs <= 5000, maxSnapshotBytes}) serialised through a promise chain with default restore delay 450 ms (mac) / 150 ms; typed error codes unsupported/unavailable/invalid-payload/failed.
verevonRelevance: Copy-as-rich-text with source links from agent messages is a daily-use feature; serialise clipboard operations and restore state.
notes: The purpose of setAndPaste (pasting into the focused app vs the composer) is not stated in the bundle (INF).

name: Context menu for text, links, images and misspelled words
what: Right-click offers Copy Link, Open Link, Copy Image, Copy Image URL, Copy Email Address, Search with Google, Paste and Match Style, Look Up (macOS), Add to Dictionary and spelling suggestions.
how: contextMenuEpic builds an Electron menu from context-menu params; strings are localised; CONTEXT_MENU_CLICKED/CLOSE return to the web app for custom items.
verevonRelevance: Table stakes for any message surface in a native wrapper.

name: Spell-check with 45+ downloadable dictionaries and per-session language selection
what: Users pick one or more spell-check languages; dictionaries are fetched from Slack's CDN on demand and the web composer queries misspelling and suggestions through the shell.
how: session.setSpellCheckerLanguages restricted to a known language map (about 45 locales with native names); dictionaries from spellcheck.slack-edge.com/dictionaries_v2/ (and .mil/.gov hosts) via DICTIONARY_EVENTS epic; window.desktop.spellCheckerV3 {getAvailableLanguages, getCurrentLanguages, setCurrentLanguages, isWordMisspelled, getWordSuggestions} using webFrame.
verevonRelevance: Multi-language spell-check matters for Norwegian/English mixed teams; Verevon composer has none documented.

name: Recent files shelf: Windows Recent scan, native thumbnails and main-process upload with confirmation
what: The composer can offer recently used local files (up to 10 within 7 days) with thumbnails; choosing one uploads it after a native "You're about to share the file ... Proceed?" confirmation, without the web page ever seeing the file path.
how: RecentFiles service: scans app.getPath("recent") .lnk targets, excludes app data/temp, filters excluded extensions, caches thumbnails via nativeImage.createThumbnailFromPath (clamped 64-2048 px; explicit requests validated to <=512), keeps id -> path only in main (renderer gets id, name, extension, size, timestamps, thumb); explicit requests are validated to at most 10 files used within 7 days (internal defaults 20 files / 14 days) and at most 10 are returned; UPLOAD_RECENT_FILE shows a message box then calls files.getUploadURL, uploads the file stream to the returned URL and calls files.completeUpload with channel, thread_ts and broadcast.
verevonRelevance: Capability-by-id (renderer never gets paths) is the right pattern for agent file access in Spaces.
notes: Quality 5: privacy-preserving by construction; upload token still comes from the web app.

name: Command centre entry point reachable from tray and global hotkey (assistant surface)
what: The tray click and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+K both open the "command center" overlay in the web app; the log string calls it Slackbot Mini, suggesting it is Slack's assistant entry point.
how: See tray and global-shortcut records: shell raises the window and sends NOTIFY_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TRIGGER(desktop_command_center); the overlay itself is web-rendered and not in the bundle; slackb.* hosts appear among the trusted domain families (their purpose is not determined here).
verevonRelevance: An OS-level "ask my agent" overlay that does not require opening a room is a differentiator for personal agents.
notes: Low confidence: only the naming links the overlay to the assistant.

name: No agent runtime, sandbox, browser/PC control or approvals exist in the desktop shell
what: The Slack desktop shell contains no agent harness: no sandbox, no tool-call cards, no scheduled work, no approvals; any agent features live in the remote web client or platform.
how: Runtime dependencies are 8 native helpers (keymap, desktop-utils, cf-prefs, native-auth, file-handler-info, notification state, focus assist, registry); no utilityProcess for agents (only 3 state probes); webPreferences sandbox is renderer hardening.
verevonRelevance: Slack's agent story is platform-side; Verevon's governed agent-in-room model is ahead on authority but behind on notification/shell polish.
notes: Absence claim with medium confidence (shell only).

name: Download manager: per-team records, progress, taskbar progress, folder chooser with fallbacks
what: Downloads show progress, survive restarts, can be opened or revealed, and go to a user-chosen folder with automatic fallback to Desktop or TEMP.
how: Epics INITIALIZE_DOWNLOADS_DIRECTORY, START_FILE_DOWNLOAD, UPDATE_DOWNLOAD, SET_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS (taskbar progress), CANCEL_DOWNLOADS, OPEN_DOWNLOAD, CLEANUP_VERIFIED_DOWNLOADS; downloads state keyed teamId -> fileId (id, url, startTime, endTime, downloadState, downloadPath, progress, appVersion); SHOW_DOWNLOAD_FOLDER_CHOOSER with macOS security-scoped bookmarks; web app uses window.desktop.downloads.
verevonRelevance: Artifacts produced by agents need a download center with provenance and open-safety (see download safety).

name: Cloud file pickers (Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive) open as typed child windows with their own logs
what: Attaching from cloud storage opens provider pickers in managed windows that the shell recognises and logs separately.
how: URL patterns files/import/box|dropbox|gdrive|onedrive classify webContents into types box|dropbox|gdrive|onedrive; each gets a console log file (<type>-picker-console) and the standard hardening.
verevonRelevance: Connector pickers for Spaces (SharePoint/OneDrive for Norwegian orgs) should reuse a controlled child-window model.

name: External-link interstitial for app protocols with "Always open links to host" memory
what: Clicking a link that opens another app (for example ftp or smb) shows a plain explanation page with Open link and a checkbox to always allow that protocol for that host.
how: SHOW_URL_SCHEME_MODAL epic and a renderer page using strings "This link opens an app, not a website" and "Always open {protocol} links to {hostname}"; WHITELIST_PROTOCOL reducer stores allowedHostnames per protocol or whitelisted schemes; ALLOWLIST_FILE_EXT stores always-open file extensions.
verevonRelevance: Use the same consent pattern when an agent proposes opening non-web protocols.

name: Failure UX: loading screen, "Slack cannot connect" page with log download, crash/hang dialogs
what: When the web app cannot load, users see a clear offline/blocked page with steps (check network and security software, restart to clear cache, download logs for support) instead of a blank window.
how: app://error page and renderer strings ("Slack cannot connect", "download your logs", "Other things to try"), SET_PAGE_FAIL_LOAD IPC from critical-script load errors (data-critical attribute), desktop_loading_screen flag, Download/Stop logging buttons backed by the log pipeline.
evidence: slack/dist/preload.bundle.js#c710556 critical script failure hook (script data-critical attribute)
verevonRelevance: Verevon should ship an explicit "cannot reach Verevon" state with a self-serve diagnostic export.

name: Default sidebar palette and workspace colour themes (aubergine) mirrored into the shell
what: Each workspace has an 8-colour sidebar theme; the shell falls back to a default aubergine palette for the title bar and badges.
how: Preload default theme {column_bg #4D394B, hover_item #3E313C, active_item #4C9689, active_presence #38978D, badge #EB4D5C, text #FFFFFF, titlebar #232323}; team schema theme {active_item, active_item_text, active_presence, badge, column_bg, hover_item, menu_bg, text_color}.
verevonRelevance: Per-org colour theming helps users keep tenants apart; Verevon already has themes, consider org accents.

name: Docs/canvas-style "posts" windows tracked as workspace-scoped web contents
what: Long-form documents open in their own window type; the shell works out which workspace a document window belongs to from its URL history so menus, badges and sign-out behave correctly.
how: URL classification maps /docs paths to webContents type "posts" (other types: app, auth, report_issue); ASSOCIATE_WEB_CONTENTS_WITH_WORKSPACE inspects the navigation history for a workspace id and dispatches ASSOCIATE_WEB_CONTENTS {workspaceId, webContentsId}, stored in webContentsAssociations.
verevonRelevance: Artifacts (docs, runs, boards) opened in separate windows must stay bound to the owning Space/org for access and sign-out purposes.
notes: Whether "posts" are canvases or legacy Posts is INF; the /docs route suggests documents.

name: Internal developer sign-in (TSAuth/toolbelt OAuth) with an encrypted token file and gated menu item
what: Slack staff can authenticate dev environments through an internal OAuth flow; the token blob is encrypted with the OS keystore and the menu entry only appears when flags and dev mode allow it.
how: OAuth against toolbelt.tinyspeck.com with slack://toolbelt-callback; tokens persisted through safeStorage.encryptString in userData (file not read); TSAuth cookies (machine-cookie, slauth-session, tsa2) are set for internal domains from env credentials with 7-day expiry; "Authenticate TSAuth session" menu gated by tsauthSessionMenuItem flag and isDevToolsEnabled.
verevonRelevance: Staff/dev auth paths must be separable and removable from production builds; keep them behind compile-time flags.
notes: Secret-bearing file toolbelt-tokens was skipped (name only).

name: Raised Chromium per-host connection limits for Slack domains
what: The app lifts Chromium's per-host connection limit for Slack hosts so many parallel requests (messages, files, images) are not queued.
how: app.commandLine.appendSwitch("ignore-connections-limit", <comma list of Slack hosts>) with a wider list for dev/devEnv builds; combined with disable-renderer-backgrounding and the always-disabled throttling features.
verevonRelevance: Tuning transport limits is only possible in a host; for a web SPA, HTTP/2 multiplexing and incremental sync are the equivalents.
notes: Host list constants (o.l$, o.T4, ...) not expanded.

name: About, What's New, Release Notes and Notices windows
what: Native windows show version information, release notes and open-source acknowledgements, and a "What's New" entry opens from the Help menu.
how: Component windows about-box.html (CSP + SRI) with strings "Notices and acknowledgements"; SHOW_RELEASE_NOTES epic opens the web-hosted release notes; Help menu items What's New and Release Notes; build script collect-release-notes gathers notes at packaging time.
verevonRelevance: Version/release-note surfacing keeps agent-host users informed about behaviour changes.

name: Native addon layer: one in-house N-API module plus seven small OS helpers
what: Everything the web runtime cannot do on Windows or macOS is done by eight native modules: input hooks, focus control, notification and Focus Assist state, registry/managed-policy access, default-app lookup, MSIX lifecycle, clipboard paste, screen-share border, voice isolation and OS search indexing.
how: @tinyspeck/slack-desktop-utils 1.27.0 (PE32+ x64, N-API v8 prebuilt, Salesforce UNLICENSED) exposes namespaces accelerator, app (registerRestart, registerPackage, getPackageInfo, getActivationType), audio (startVoiceIsolatedCapture), clipboard (setAndPaste, readText), fs (isMountPoint), huddles (WindowBorderPanel), input (activateTouchpadHaptics), power (isSystemAutomaticallyResumed), search (index), systemPreferences (notifier state, StartupTask, canInitAudioDeviceWin, registry listeners, notification authorization) and window (forceAllowFocus); plus native-keymap, registry-js, windows-focus-assist, cf-prefs, macos-notification-state, electron-native-auth and file-handler-info. All eight .node files in this Windows package are PE images (the macOS-named ones are Windows builds of the same packages). Heavy or hang-prone probes run in utilityProcess/worker entry points.
evidence: REA ev_2a90444feeb793611259f458eb756194e4f6f2766a044417716bf34a9f2ec0e8 (inspect_pe_resources slackdesktoputils.node: PE32+ x64, one RT_MANIFEST)

slack/node_modules/@tinyspeck/slack-desktop-utils/lib/binding/napi-v8/slackdesktoputils.node (export names read from binary strings: getComboTapStats, getModelName, getNotifierState, updateMsix, requestNotificationAuthorization ...)
verevonRelevance: A narrow in-house native layer behind validated IPC is the safest way to give Verevon hosts OS powers (hotkeys, focus, hardware model) without exposing them to web code.
notes: Provenance REA for the PE identity/manifest (inspect_pe_resources) combined with SRC reading of the JS wrapper and binary strings; no native decompilation was performed. package.json says the module targets Electron 42.2.0 headers while the app runs Electron 44.4.5 (N-API v8 keeps the ABI stable).
